summary: A well-presented three bedroom semi-detached family home offering comfortable living space, a spacious rear garden, and the convenience of off-road parking. Ideal for families seeking a practical and welcoming home in a desirable residential location.
description:
ENTRANCE HALL A welcoming entrance hall featuring a laminate floor and a double-glazed uPVC external door.

LOUNGE A bright and spacious lounge featuring a characterful fireplace and a double glazed window overlooking the front garden, creating a warm and inviting living space.

KITCHEN A well appointed kitchen fitted with an integral electric oven, five ring gas hob with extractor fan and a range of wall and base units in white high gloss with contrasting wood finishes. The kitchen also features a sink basin with mixer tap and a stylish integrated wine rack.

DINING ROOM A versatile room suitable for use as a dining room or second reception room, featuring uPVC doors that lead directly into the conservatory, creating a flexible and light filled living space ideal for entertaining or family use.

CONSERVATORY A large and bright conservatory offering an excellent additional living space, filled with natural light and providing views over the garden, ideal for relaxing, dining, or entertaining throughout the year.

MASTER BEDROOM A generously sized master bedroom featuring large mirrored wardrobes and a window overlooking the front garden, providing a bright space.

BEDROOM

Second double bedroom to the rear, with ample space for free standing wardrobes.

BEDROOM Single bedroom to the front of the property, ideal for a nursery or home office. Built in cupboard ideal for storage.

BATHROOM A modern three piece fitted bathroom suite comprising a bath with shower over, WC, and wash hand basin, complemented by two frosted double-glazed windows that provide natural light while maintaining privacy.

EXTERNAL A large rear garden featuring a wooden pergola, providing an ideal space for outdoor relaxation. To the front, the property benefits from a spacious driveway offering ample off road parking. Conveniently located within walking distance of local schools and amenities, making it ideal for family living.
